title: Who Thinks Best Depends on How Long You Let Them: Budget-Dependent Rankings in LLM Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2608.12150v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Standard evaluation of large language models assumes stable model rankings across inference conditions. We challenge this assumption by varying the token generation budget, i.e., the maximum tokens a model may produce, across seven levels (64--4,096), evaluating four models on three reasoning benchmarks (56,476 inferences). We report four findings: (i) 3--19% of items exhibit non-monotone behavior (accuracy decreasing with more budget), even after controlling for truncation, and this phenomenon is model-specific (cross-model overlap: 6--14%). (ii) Model rankings reverse across budgets on all benchmarks ($p {<} 0.01$, McNemar). (iii) Oracle analysis reveals model complementarity up to $+27.8$pp, most pronounced at constrained budgets. (iv) A budget-aware router captures 14.1% of the oracle gap cross-domain; budget features help within-domain ($+1.6$ to $+5.7$pp) but are domain-specific and hurt transfer ($-1.2$pp). translated_title: 谁思考得最好取决于你给他们多长时间：大语言模型评估中的预算依赖排名
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.12150v1 公告类型：新 摘要：大语言模型的标准评估假设模型排名在不同推理条件下保持稳定。我们通过改变令牌生成预算（即模型可能生成的最大令牌数）来挑战这一假设，在七个级别（64至4,096）上，对三个推理基准（共56,476次推理）上的四个模型进行评估。我们报告了四个发现：（i）3%至19%的项目表现出非单调行为（准确率随预算增加而下降），即使在控制截断后也是如此，且这种现象具有模型特异性（跨模型重叠：6%至14%）。（ii）在所有基准上，模型排名随预算变化而逆转（$p < 0.01$，McNemar检验）。（iii）预言机分析揭示了模型互补性，最高可达$+27.8$个百分点，在受限预算下最为显著。（iv）一个预算感知路由器捕获了跨领域预言机差距的14.1%；预算特征有助于领域内表现（$+1.6$至$+5.7$个百分点），但具有领域特异性，并损害迁移能力（$-1.2$个百分点）。这些结果论证了...
tldr: 该论文发现大语言模型的评估排名随令牌生成预算变化而逆转，表明标准评估假设不成立，并提出预算感知路由器可部分利用模型互补性。
en_tdlr: This paper finds that LLM evaluation rankings reverse with token generation budgets, challenging standard assumptions, and proposes a budget-aware router to partially exploit model complementarity.
